display.purpose: SOULRIFT logotype and landing title only. Never inside the app shell.

headline.purpose: Screen titles — the active area of the observatory.

title.purpose: Card names, spell names, tower names, panel section heads.

body.purpose: Spell descriptions, dungeon lore, functional system copy.

label.purpose: Section dividers, nav labels, badges, HUD metadata.

shadows.name: md
shadows.purpose: Raised cards, hovered options, selected states.

shadows.name: lg
shadows.purpose: Sheet drawers, hovered tower cards, toasts.

shadows.name: glow-gold-sm
shadows.purpose: Focused inputs, selected cards at rest.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Max app width. Above this, app is centered with dark outer frame.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The gold invocation — the heaviest commitment in the system. Used for primary combat, forge, and confirm actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(197,160,89,0.60); background: linear-gradient(145deg, #6a4e1e, #c5a059 45%, #9a7a40); color: #080808; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(197,160,89,0.20), 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.75); transition: filter 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; user-select: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.14); box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(197,160,89,0.25), 0 0 40px rgba(197,160,89,0.10), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.85); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(.88); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .28; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Dormant secondary action. Activates to gold on hover. Used for cancel, secondary choices, filter toggles.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .02em; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(197,160,89,0.22); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); color: #a09880; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease, background 120ms ease; user-select: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(197,160,89,0.50); color: #e8c070; background: rgba(197,160,89,0.05); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { filter: brightness(.85); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Irreversible or destructive action. Deep crimson — the color of a seal that should not be broken.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(184,48,48,0.50); background: linear-gradient(145deg, #5a0e0e, #8b1a1a); color: #e8e0d0; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(1.18); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(184,48,48,0.25); } .ds-btn-danger:active { filter: brightness(.85); transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Base Card
components.description: The standard observatory panel. Carries the mandatory upper-left specular gradient.
components.css: .ds-card { background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.018) 0%, transparent 60%), #141420; border: 1px solid rgba(197,160,89,0.10); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.75), inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.70); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Recessed into the void. Cinzel for character names, Inter for search. Gold border glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-input-label { font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #a09880; letter-spacing: .20em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #09090f; border: 1px solid rgba(197,160,89,0.22); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-size: 15px; color: #e8e0d0; letter-spacing: .08em; outline: none; transition: border-color 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.80); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(197,160,89,0.50); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(197,160,89,0.20), inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.80); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #605850; font-style: italic; font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Badge — Gold
components.description: Tight archival label. Nine-point Cinzel, uppercase. Used for item level, tower affiliation, rarity tier.
components.css: .ds-badge-gold { display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: .10em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(197,160,89,.12); color: #e8c070; border: 1px solid rgba(197,160,89,.32); }

components.name: Badge — Rarity (Epic)
components.description: Rarity tier badge. Each rarity maps to a specific color from the palette. Shown as an example at epic tier.
components.css: .ds-badge-epic { display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: .10em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(136,64,200,.12); color: #8840c8; border: 1px solid rgba(136,64,200,.32); }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Observatory instrument label. Marks categorical shifts within a panel — not a rhythm device for every section.
components.css: .ds-section-label { font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; color: #7a6030; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .28em; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-section-label::before { content: '▸'; font-size: 8px; color: #d4aa55; opacity: .7; } .ds-section-label::after { content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(197,160,89,0.22), transparent); }

components.name: Toast — Gold
components.description: Victory notification — rare item discovery, level-up, major reward. Gold border, gold text, glow.
components.css: .ds-toast-gold { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.03), transparent), #1a1a28; border: 1px solid rgba(197,160,89,0.50); border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 16px; font-size: 12px; color: #e8c070; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(197,160,89,0.20), 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.90); animation: ds-toast-in .18s ease; } @keyframes ds-toast-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px) scale(.97); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } }

narrative.overview:
SOULRIFT's design system is a relic, not a product. Every screen is an instrument panel inside a sealed observatory: celestial machinery in dark iron, star-charts inked in aged gold, brass fittings that glow faintly when the rift opens. The interface does not present information — it reveals it, slowly, to those patient enough to look.

The system carries two modes simultaneously: the oppressive stillness of deep space (dark backgrounds, near-invisible borders, long shadows) and the sudden revelation of forbidden light (gold glows, tower-color flares, crimson danger). These two states — dormant and activated — define every interactive moment.

This system explicitly rejects: mobile F2P visual noise, anime/JRPG softness, generic fantasy parchment, SaaS dashboard flatness, and any surface that explains itself before it has been touched.
keyCharacteristics: Void-dark foundation with near-invisible layering — depth without noise
Gold as the single primary accent; all other colors are elemental roles or system states
Cinzel serif for all game language; Inter for functional body copy — two registers, never mixed
Components inscribed and revealed: dormant until activated, then they glow
SVG grain noise + cosmic radial gradients as atmosphere — the texture of the observatory itself
Touch-first: 44px minimum tap targets, one-thumb reachability throughout

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Gold appears on ≤15% of any screen's surface area. Its scarcity is the mechanism. An interface where everything glows gold is an interface where nothing does.

rules.name: The One Tower Rule
rules.body: A single tower's color governs all active states on a given screen. Fire and Ice never coexist in active states.

rules.name: The Two Registers Rule
rules.body: Cinzel belongs to the world; Inter belongs to the interface. Never use Cinzel for body-length descriptions and never use Inter for game entity names, spell titles, or level identifiers.

rules.name: The Uppercase Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is for labels (≤4 words) and proper nouns used as labels. Never used for body-length prose.

rules.name: The Glow Restraint Rule
rules.body: Glows appear only in response to interaction. A surface glowing at rest is an error. Exception: the landing screen's star field, which is ambient by design.

dos: Do keep #05050a as the body background on every screen — non-negotiable.
Do add the linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.018)...) specular to every card surface.
Do use border opacity (subtle → mid → bright) to build depth signals.
Do restrict Cinzel to the game register: entity names, screen titles, spell names, labels ≤4 words.
Do pair new interactive states with filter: brightness() rather than background color shifts.
Do scope tower colors to data-tower-attributed elements only.
Do add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) alternatives for every animation.
donts: Don't introduce warm-neutral backgrounds (beige, cream, parchment). There is no day mode.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient. All text uses solid palette colors.
Don't use gold as a fill on large surfaces. The primary button gradient is the single exception.
Don't make components glow at rest without user interaction.
Don't add glassmorphism as a default treatment on new components.
Don't use more than two fonts (Cinzel + Inter is the complete pair).
Don't replicate mobile F2P visual language: badge-dots at rest, countdown timers, rainbow rarity shines.
Don't add eyebrow labels above every section. The section-label component marks categorical shifts only.
